articleTitle: Remote monitoring of human cardiorespiratory system parameters by radar and its applications
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The diagnostic monitoring of humans (as well as their detection behind of the opaque obstacles), by means of radar have called bio-radiolocation. As an illustration ultra-wideband (UWB) radar in medicine and in psychophysiology for remote measuring of patientpsilas heart activity and respiration is shown. The measuring method is described and practical results of tests are cited. New technical decisions on hardware and software which allow obtaining reliable physiological data at the monitoring of back-and-forth motion of objects are considered. This paper considers various applications of the bio-radiolocation.

articleTitle: Time domain analysis of reflected impulse fields by artificial neural network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The impulse fields reflected from layered medium with losses are analyzed by artificial neural network in time domain directly. The normal incidence of plane wave with Gaussian time form on layered medium is considered. The reflected electromagnetic field is obtained by FDTD method. Initial data for neural network are the values of amplitude of electrical component of reflected field chosen with constant time step. As an example the network is trained to determine the thickness of one of the layers of the medium.

articleTitle: Scanning coherent tomography of multilayered media with inhomogeneous region
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: New methods of the coherent tomography are proposed for layered media with embedded 3D inhomogeneous structures. The retrieval of the structure of media parameters is based on the solution of 3D integral equations of the perturbation theory that are reduced to convolution equations with respect to lateral co-ordinates using the lateral 2D Fourier transform and the plane wavespsila decomposition of Green functions. Results of numerical simulation are presented.

articleTitle: The structural features of ultrawideband signals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A method for investigation of complex superposition of ultrawideband signals is considered in this paper. Based on repeated integration the method enables to increase the resolving ability and to improve the estimation of amplitude and time parameters of partial signals in superposition.

articleTitle: High decoupled antenna for UWB pulse GPR “ODYAG”
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A principle of operation and arrangement of UWB antenna system which differs from other with very high frequency independent electromagnetic decoupling are described in the paper. Peculiar design of the antenna makes it possible to use it in two different modes - horizontal scanning mode and accurate definition of local object location mode. The antenna system is designed for the ground penetrating radar ldquoODYAGrdquo monitoring of subsurface structure of asphalted roads.

articleTitle: Wideband properties of a new antenna made of cold plasma
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The results of research of internal and external characteristics of a microwave loop antenna produced on a basis of cold plasma of a gas discharge are presented. It is shown that frequency properties of the input impedance and radiation characteristics for the plasma antenna exceed the parameters of usual dipole loop antennas.

articleTitle: A novel uwb pulse design method of optimizing combination with differential Gaussian pulse
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Based on linear combination with differential Gaussian pulse, a designing impulse radio waveforms’ method for ultrawideband (UWB) wireless communications was investigated. According to the spread spectrum effect of the shaping factor and differential coefficient, a novel method on constructing differential Gaussian pulse was proposed. So as to gain the best weight coefficient, a integrated algorithm based on the minimum mean square error (MMSE) and weight coefficient calculation is applied to the signal construction. The simulation results show that the linear combined UWB pulse indoors and outdoors have the best ability of limit approach to the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) emission mask rule, and what’s more, it has the best performance of bits of error rate (BER) and ranging and many other merits, such as high rate of using spectrum, strong controllable power and flexible design, et al.

articleTitle: Radioacoustic sounding with the use of wideband acoustic impulses
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In the paper, possibilities of high-power wideband acoustic pulses for RASS are analyzed. It is taken into account that at propagation of unfilled acoustic impulses, effects of their nonlinear interaction with the air do not reveal themselves. An engineering mathematical model is built for propagation of the acoustic impulse from the gun shot in the neutral atmosphere with regard of the divergence, classic and relaxation absorption of sound waves in the air, and values of the impulse front cross-section for radio waves are obtained. Cross-sections of impulse fronts are compared with those of the atmospheric turbulent inhomogeneities. The results of comparison have shown that the echo-signal from the impulse front exceeds in level the echo-signal from the turbulent atmospheric inhomogeneities. This confirms the practical realizability of such a RASS method that allows simplifying the RASS equipment, lowering its cost and decreasing its dimensions.

articleTitle: Dual regularization in inverse problem of low frequency dielectric profiling
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The new approach of dual regularization is applied to the problem of geomagnetic low frequency profiling of conductivity of earth crust.

articleTitle: Investigation of the dielectric cover influence on the microstrip antenna’s characteristics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The dielectric cover influence on the main characteristics of microstrip antennas: resonance frequency, input impedance, VSWR is investigated. The comparative analysis of the microstrip antennas characteristics with dielectric cover and without it is carried out.

articleTitle: System spectral analysis of the ultrawideband signals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The new integrated signal analysis method called as system spectral analysis and based on the simultaneous application of the set of linear and non-linear integral transforms is proposed and realized. The abilities of the system spectral analysis at the sample of investigation of the terahertz electromagnetic pulse considered as ultrawideband (UWB) signal are shown.

articleTitle: Resonant length and input impedance of a nonsymmetrical dipole
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: On the base of the induced electromotive forces method with using the uniform geometric diffraction theory a technique for calculating the input impedance and the resonant length of a nonsymmetrical dipole placed on the rectangular metal screen is developed. Influence of the form and sizes of the screen on resonant length and input impedance of this dipole is investigated.

articleTitle: Microwave multifrequency radar images of dielectric structures
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The results of microwave measurements for some objects combining multifrequency measurements and transversal scanning is presented. Longitudinal distance dependencies of reflectivity have been obtained by synthesis from multifrequency data. The multifrequency measurements and synthesis have been done in real-time. The measurements in free space were carried out by the apparatus using measuring modules of scalar reflectometer of series P2 (R2). The combination of data in longitudinal and transversal directions produced radio images of some dielectric structures.

articleTitle: The synthesis of ultra-wideband devices in frequency domain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The mathematical model of irregular line with T-waves is obtained. The analytic form of frequency characteristic is described. The dependence between frequency characteristics of irregular line reflection coefficient and function of line local reflections makes possible to determine configuration of line. So lot of Ultra-Wideband devices such as filters, matching devices, antennas may be created.

articleTitle: Search and control of state of people under avalanches
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In the article principles of design of system for search people under avalanches which is equipped with sensor for determination of heart rhythm of people are discussed. Measuring of heart rhythm of people is possible due to Doppler effect. Detachment of Doppler frequency is based on homodyne method of conversion of signal.

articleTitle: Calculation of pulse wave propagation in a quasi-TEM line using mode expansion in time domain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The paper considers pulse propagation in a transverse inhomogeneous waveguide supporting a quasi-TEM wave. The calculation is based on presenting the sought fields in terms of mode expansion with mode amplitudes being functions of time and longitudinal coordinate (Mode Basis Method). In case of transverse inhomogeneous waveguide there is coupling between the modes. Meanwhile a very good convergence of such a mode series is shown here. The obtained solution was verified by direct FDTD calculation.

articleTitle: Investigation of electromagnetic field structure in the near-field region of antenna
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: It was shown that simplified methods of antenna properties analysis usually do not fully describe characteristics of electromagnetic processes especially when considering the near-field region of the antenna. With the help of the generalized induced EMF method the main characteristics of simple wire antennas were calculated and the peculiarities of the structure of electromagnetic field in the near-field region are investigated. The clear visual interpretation of the investigated phenomena taking place when the electromagnetic waves are radiated is proposed.

articleTitle: Symmetry in target recognition
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Symmetry has important consequences for target recognition. Rotation and reflection symmetry for targets near a ground or water surface not only help to identify the targets, but also aid in data processing to increase accuracy. While clutter (other scatterers) interfere with the target signatures, symmetry in the clutter can be used to suppress this interference.

articleTitle: Effect of optical excitation level on the MSM-detector high-speed response
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: High-speed response of the metal-semiconductor-metal (MSM) detectors is analyzed. Effect of optical excitation level on the MSM-photodetector performance is discussed. At low excitation level the detector speed of response is limited by parasitic capacitance of interdigitated diode structure and by the transit time of the photogenerated carriers. At high excitation level the detector speed of response is limited by the field screening caused by the space-charge of the holes. The impulse response of GaN MSM-detector is compared favorably with GaAs MSM-device.

articleTitle: Analysis and model synthesis of resonant units for radiators of high-power short radio pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The paper deals with the theoretical problems associated with simulation of transient and steady-state processes in radiators of high-power short radio pulses.

articleTitle: Generator of pulses with amplitude up to 1 MV and power up to 11 GW having radiator of spiral antennas
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Generator of decaying sinusoidal pulses with power up to 11 GW was created and successfully tested. Pulse amplitude reaches 1 MV, radiated energy per pulse is more than 100 J. Mode of stable operation of 16 conical spiral antennas with axial conductor in each was experimentally obtained. Under voltage of 300 kV on input of forming device, strength of radiated electric field of ~3 kV/m at the distance of 4 m from radiator was registered.

articleTitle: CMOS 0.18-μm integrated power amplifier for UWB systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A two-stage power amplifier for UWB systems transmitter was designed and simulated for implementing in standard 0.18-mum CMOS technology. Using cascode scheme and original biasing architecture allows to decrease a number of on-chip inductors and capacitors and simplify amplifier schematic. Amplifier can deliver 30 mW of output power with 48% efficiency in 4-5 GHz bandwidth with 1.8 supply voltage.

articleTitle: Spectral estimation and digital UWB signal processing by atomic functions and wavelets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In this report the new approach based on combination of atomic functions (AF) and classical spectral kernels is proposed and proved. Shown that obtained structures have some advantages in comparison with spectral wave analysis of ultra-wideband (UWB) signals.

articleTitle: Double-drift diodes for super wideband noise oscillator with increased noise level
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: 50...70 dB/kT<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> ENR levels are obtained during avalanche diode in anomaly mode based wideband noise oscillators research. Specially developed impulse method makes double-drift diodepsilas selection possible just as allows to determine drift region chargepsilas asymmetry for obtaining great ENR level.

Author Keywords: p- and n- drift region’s asymmetry

articleTitle: The broadband compact antenna with the radiation field of circular polarization
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In the report possibility of expansion of a strip of the coordination is discussed at build-up of antenna system on the basis of flat spiral structures at the expense of magnification of initial radius of spirals and application of conical transition on an inlet of radiators. The law of winding of a conductor in conical transition at which in a wide frequency band the qualitative coordination of the antenna without use matched devices and stable radiation characteristics of the antenna is provided is offered.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of permittivity profile by Gel’fand-Levitan method using reflectometry data extrapolation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: New approach to permittivity profile reconstruction based on Gelpsilafand-Levitan iterative scheme is considered. The impulse reflection response data being the ground for reconstruction is examined to be obtained with use of microwave reflection coefficient data extrapolation technique completed with discrete Fourier transform. This extrapolation technique provides possibility of treating with the problem of impulse polarity determination being the obstacle for common spectral analysis methods. Extrapolation is carried through special nonquadratic regularization procedure based on minimum duration method. Result of numerical data processing is presented.

articleTitle: Experimental researches of wideband connection wireless access system WiMAX by streets waves channels distribution signals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The new experimental results of wideband signals distribution of the WiMAX radio access system on the wave channels of large industrial center streets (Kharkov, Ukraine) are presented in thesis.

articleTitle: Comparison of two methods of generation of ultra wideband signals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In article principles of generation of different types of ultra wideband signals are considered. The most simple and widespread principles of generation of ultra wideband signals are considered, that in the light of increasing attention to ultra wideband technology it should be interesting for.

articleTitle: Wideband antenna array of circular and linear polarization
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The results of research of internal and external characteristics of ultra wideband vibrator antenna arrays of circular and linear polarization with capacity elements in every vibrator are considered.

articleTitle: Influence of ultrawideband microwave radiation on seeds of rape
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The results of microwave measurements for some objects combining multifrequency measurements and transversal scanning is presented. Longitudinal distance dependencies of reflectivity have been obtained by synthesis from multifrequency data. The multifrequency measurements and synthesis have been done in real-time. The measurements in free space were carried out by the apparatus using measuring modules of scalar reflectometer of series P2 (R2). The combination of data in longitudinal and transversal directions produced radio images of some dielectric structures.

articleTitle: To 70th anniversary of Prof. Oleg A. Tretyakov
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals

articleTitle: Modification of pole model for wideband responses of distributed structures
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: For more effective approximation of wideband responses of the distributed structures the necessity of a modification of pole model is shown. Refinement of the model for the account of beam propagation in an open distributed structure and for the account of frequency dependence of the model parameters is suggested. Efficiency of the considered approach is demonstrated on the numerical example.

articleTitle: Wavelet analysis of the ultrawideband signals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The results of the wavelet analysis application to the ultrawideband (UWB) signal investigation are introduced. The continuous wavelet transform, the analytic wavelet transform, the discrete wavelet transform, the wavelet packets, the stationary wavelet transform and the Kravchenko-Rvachev analytic wavelets based on the atomic functions have been used to the analysis of the UWB signals and processes.

articleTitle: Neural-genetic optimization applied to the design of UWB planar antennas
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A novel concept of neural-genetic optimization is presented as applied to ultrawideband planar antennas of ldquobow-tierdquo type with respect to specified values of antenna performance (return loss and gain) in the frequency range 3.1-10.6 GHz. The goal of the optimization is achieved by properly modifying the radiating contour profile of the conventional triangular taper of the bow-tie antenna. The key feature of the optimization is an inversion of artificial neural networks (ANN) with a modular architecture using genetic algorithm (GA). An optimized prototype antenna shows a good impedance matching (return loss < -10 dB) and gain performance (increase from 2 to 5 dB) over the whole frequency range.

articleTitle: Pulse electromagnetic wave scattering by plane dielectric interface
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Results of numerical simulation of pulse cylindrical electromagnetic wave scattering by a dielectric half-space with a plane interface have been presented in the given work. This simulation has been done by the finite-difference time-domain method (FDTD). A change of field characteristics with changing the radiator position and observation points as well as radiated pulse duration and dielectric characteristics of the scatter has been investigated. A possible effect of these parameters on the probability of subsurface object detection in radar problems has been considered.

articleTitle: Transient oscillations in a cavity with dispersive double negative medium
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Excitation of electromagnetic fields by a wideband current pulse in a cavity filled with double negative dispersive medium and bounded by a closed perfectly conducting surface is studied. Some features of eigenfrequencies of such electromagnetic system are presented. Transient field evolution is shown.

articleTitle: To 80th anniversary of Prof. Henning F. Harmuth
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals

articleTitle: New parameters of the ultrawideband signals and processes
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The possibility of distinguishing of the ultrawideband (UWB) and frequency modulated (FM) signals is considered. It is demonstrated that FM signal, being narrowband in each instant of time, with the traditional UWB signal definition usage can be falsely classified as the UWB signal. The dynamic fractional bandwidth conception based on the analysis of the spectral density function of short-time Fourier transform is proposed. The efficiency of the new criterion based on this conception for FM signal analysis is shown.

articleTitle: Feed model for the tapered slot antennas
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In this paper we will describe the feed model for the tapered slot antennas (TSAs) and will find one of the important parameter of this model-transformation coefficient.

articleTitle: Cell recovery from ultrawideband pulse irradiation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The process of recovery from ultrawideband pulse irradiation was studied in isolated human buccal epithelium cells. The influence of irradiation was registered by the effect of chromatin condensation. Chromatin condensation was determined in cell nuclei by the method of heterochromatin granules counting in orcein stained cells. Irradiation induced chromatin condensation. After irradiation at the intensity of 1 mW/sm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> cell recovery was observed after 1 hour. After 2 hours of recovery the level of heterochromatinization became close to the control level. After irradiation at the intensity of 10 mW/sm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> no full recovery was observed.

articleTitle: Background of restudying on Poisson’s bispinor equation in electromagnetic field
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: This paper deals with the background of restudying upon Poissonpsilas bispinor equation. The main properties of the vector potential and Poissonpsilas bispinor equation in the electromagnetic filed are analyzed. Besides the process introducing Poissonpsilas bispinor equation in electromagnetic field, a series of inquiries, which maybe either well known or unfamiliar by people, are proposed.

articleTitle: Recipes for efficient higher-order multiscale asymptotic analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Realistic models for physical phenomena in singular perturbation theory often involve multiscale processes which need to be regularized systematically and carefully. A case in point is when the roughness (non-smoothness) of the solution is confined to a small portion of the simulation domain. In the past decades considerable efforts have been made in developing asymptotic solutions for multiscale problems. However, the majority of works only provide the first few dominant expansion terms due to the complexity of the iteration involved in the so-called ldquoMethod of Matched Asymptotic Expansions.rdquo The primary objectives in this paper are (i) to establish a convenient symbolic notation for the derivation of the asymptotics to any order desired; (ii) to demonstrate that the involved matching process in the algorithms occurs on the boundary rather than on boundary layers; (iii) to propose a technique which revises the usage of the O - calculus by making redundant a variety of intermediate calculation steps in standard analyses. Details will be discussed in terms of a model problem.

articleTitle: About synthesis of the wideband radioabsorbing layer
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The problem of the synthesis of simple wideband radioabsorbing material has been considered. Common regularity has been established for the frequency characteristics of the reflection coefficient for the material possessing volume electrical conductivity. The simple engineering formulas are proposed which make it possible to carry out the synthesis of the ultra wideband radioabsorbing material. The effectiveness of the using of this material for absorbing the ultrawideband signal in a wide angle sector of the incidence has been shown.

articleTitle: Spatial coherence of the aperture antenna radiation field in a media with random inhomogeneities
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The equations for the estimation of spatial coherence of the radiation field of the aperture antenna with uniform aperture distribution are derived. The results of numerical calculations are presented.

articleTitle: On the anatomy of Wannier functions in photonic structures
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: For high-performance analysis of photonic devices, with increasingly complex material and geometrical characteristics, physics-based, problem-specific modelling tools are indispensable. Thereby, the primary task is the determination of field solutions with controllable accuracy obtained in reasonable simulation times. To this end the decomposition of the a-priori unknown field functions in suitably chosen Hilbert space bases plays a significant role. Wannier functions have been found to posses excellent localization properties in spatial domain. In this work, choosing the most basic periodic boundary value problem in electromagnetics, we provide a comprehensive analysis of the distinctively superior properties of Wannier functions, including their localization properties in spatial and spectral domains, their inner and intraband orthonormality, and the nearly-optimal partitioning of the underlying Hilbert space. These properties make Wannier functions well suited candidates for a customised multiresolution analysis.

articleTitle: An evolutionary model of impulsive circuit with transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: We suggest a method to investigate impulsive circuits with transmission lines in time domain. Transmission lines are connected by a multi-port with LCR-elements. The outputs of the lines are exposed to pulse perturbations at discrete times. The problem is described by a system of telegraph equations with boundary conditions. We pass to a vector delay differential algebraic equation. We develop theory of such equations and a numerical method to find a solution.

articleTitle: Impulse irradiation of layered medium by the open end of circular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The radiation of impulse signal from the open end of a circular waveguide is considered by analytical and direct numerical methods. The radiation of short pulse from the aperture is considered by calculation of special time form of field by means of modal basis method that permits to transform the nonstationary three-dimensional electrodynamic problem into the problem for one-dimensional evolutionary equations by means of the construction of modal basis for electromagnetic field with arbitrary time dependence. The method is applied to solve the problem of pulse evolution for positive and negative time with the use of Laplace transform by construction of operator of propagation. The approach is employed to form the short pulse on aperture of circular waveguide for irradiation of layered medium with losses.

articleTitle: About of the condition existence and unique solution for the problem of diffraction on nonlinear medium
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The diffraction of a plane wave by a transversely inhomogeneous, isotropic, nonmagnetic, linearly polarized, weakly nonlinear dielectric layered structure is considered. The diffraction problem is reduced to a system of nonlinear operator equations of the second kind solved using iterations. Sufficient conditions of the integral equation (IE) unique solvability are obtained using the contraction principle.

articleTitle: Stabilization of sampling conversion process
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The method of increasing the operating stability of the symmetric sampling gate and achievement of the ultrawide bandwidth at given parameters of strobe pulses has been considered in the present work. A circuit of the transformerless strobe pulse generator has been proposed.

articleTitle: Triode-klystron method of ultra-high band pulse-signal generation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Pulses and harmonics of convection and induced currents in the triode-klystron (tristron) have been investigated by numerical simulation. It is shown that tristron can be a generator of sub-nanosecond pulse signals with ultra-high repetition frequency. Comparison of the results computed to those obtained earlier before the experimental study was carried out.

articleTitle: Radiation properties of ultra-wideband printed-board antennas: Simulations and experimental verification
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: This paper presents some results of the work done within the frameworks of the ISTC project #B-922. The simulation data and experiments demonstrate possible techniques of improving characteristics of planar ultra-wideband (UWB) antennas based on the tapered slotline. To this end, four ultrawideband baluns, namely the 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>-order Marchand balun, microstrip to slotline transition with open cavity, two designs of radial stub baluns, and three types of aperture such as exponential Vivaldi type, elliptical flare with corrugated edges and elliptical open flare had been studied. Several planar UWB antennas with dimensions of 23 to 12 centimeters were simulated using electromagnetic simulation software, and then designed, fabricated and tested. The simulation and experimental results on the evaluation of the bandwidth and radiation pattern of the antennas are presented.

articleTitle: Calculation of the ultrawideband mirror antenna
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In work the procedure of payments of the superbroadband mirror antenna is described at the set signal of the superbroadband generator and dimensions of the antenna.

articleTitle: Kirchhoff method application in microwave radiometry of rough sea surface
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The use of hydrological (surface wind and sea wave slope) dependencies for calculation of microwave characteristics of the ldquoocean-atmosphererdquo system by Kirchhoff method is discussed here. As an important example, we review results of our experiment on bistatic sensing of the sea surface. In this experiment Sun is a powerful natural source of noise microwave radiation for the sea surface sensing. For the receiving of solar radiation in the region of quasi-specular scattering three two-polarization radiometers (0.8, 2.25 and 6.0 cm) were used. The results of joint hydrological and radiometric experiments are reported.

articleTitle: Passive VHF radar: Antenna design and optimization requirements
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Passive radars are under investigation due to its interesting potentiality: the use of independent sources is possible for the large diffusion of high power broadcasting stations. VHF stations guarantees high power and wide coverage areas. Consequently to large wavelength in this band, the antenna systems design is fundamental. The study leads to the interferometry configuration of a passive radar, configured as a couple of antennas. In order to maintain the maximum accuracy of the radar system, it is fundamental the optimization of the antenna system, including all the embedded effects. The mathematical approach is discussed and the optimization target are defined. Example of design and optimization studies are presented.

articleTitle: Improved design of the reflector impulse radiating antenna (IRA)
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The basic structure and design theory of reflector impulse radiating antenna (IRA) is introduced in this paper. And the improvement of the feeding structure of the reflector IRA is considered. Two improving method are proposed. First is the tapered design on feeding arms in comparison to traditional triangle feeding arm. The purpose of this improving method is to solve the problem of stored energy around the arm-reflector junction. Secondly a method of changing the angle of the feed arms is studied to improve the antenna performance. The simulation results for the new antennas show that gain and VSWR are improved according to both of the new designs. The IRA with tapered feeding arms located on the position of phi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> = 70deg gives an average gain improvement of 4 dB in the entire frequency compared with traditional IRA.

articleTitle: Multispectral measurement complex for remote sensing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Thus, multispectral measuring complex working in cm, mm and infrared wave-length ranges has been created. Results of experimental estimation allow to make a conclusion about possibility of locating and further identification of square as well as small-size low-contrast ground objects on the background of Earth by passive radiometric detectors of millimeter and infra-red range of wave-lengths under uncertainty conditions, and also by active detectors of centimeter and millimeter wave-range.

articleTitle: The ultra wide band monitoring system of a site of the personnel
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: One of possible alternatives of construction of system of position finding of the personnel inside the back is in-process observed.

articleTitle: Pulse radiolocation by means of two-dimensional antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A method for reconstruction of earth surface and detection adjacent objects from redundant data and by means two dimensional antennas array as transmitting and receiving systems is described in this paper. An interpretation of radiolocation images (RI) was done and main classification factors of adjacent object were presented.

articleTitle: Approach and accuracy methods for tapered slot antenna modeling
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In this paper we discuss approach and accuracy methods for tapered slot antennas excited by ultra wide band pulse. Show possibility to use it in ultra wide band technology area.

articleTitle: An approach of detection the structure of subsurface layers using reflected GPR signals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: An approach, allowing correct detection of the structure of the sounding ambience using GPR signals is suggested.

articleTitle: Radiation field of crossed vibrators system into flat-layered medium with losses
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The problem about electromagnetic waves radiation by the system of two crossed vibrators into the flat-layered medium, the layers of which model manpsilas biological tissues, has been considered in the proposed paper. The features of the electromagnetic radiation transmission in the vibrators system near zone via the interface between the layers have been found out. Influence of difference of vibrators excitation phases on polarization of tangential components of the electrical field in layers has been considered.

articleTitle: The hybrid metal-dielectric structure for wide-band applications
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The hybrid metal dielectric structure which is combined a microstrip line section and bounded periodical sequence of slot discontinuities are investigated. The boundary problem for a single discontinuity is solved with the help of spectral-domain approach. For the definition of the parameters of bounded sequences of discontinuities the operator technique is used. If one introduces the slot discontinuity into the T- wave propagation region one can observed the phenomena of leaky modes excitation around the cut-off frequencies of microstrip line is established, They may be classified as surface-wave leaky modes and space-wave leaky modes. The excitation efficiency dependence by the couple value of the discontinuity and basic waveguide is investigated.

articleTitle: Resolution of UWB noise radar on basis of retrodirective antenna array
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Comparison of resolution and a side lobe level on delay (range) and azimuth in UWB noise radar with linear equidistant transmitting antenna array and the single receiving antenna is submitted at presence and absence of signal recirculation in a feedback loop transmitting element - target - receiving element.

articleTitle: Preliminary thinking about the mathematic foundation of modern computational electromagnetism
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Computation of time-dependent electromagnetic field excited by a varying current distribution is the hardcore of modern computational electromagnetism. However, differing from other computing forms of field problem described by partial differential equations, the computation of electromagnetic field did not really use series of the general, abstract and formalized methods. And people have to construct forms of different models to make computation. Such a method of computation can also arrange forms particular propositions suitably. But, it cannot be regarded as a universal method and it is usually implicates some logic mistakes and physical distortion. The reason would be: time-dependent electromagnetic field lacks of a united mathematical physical model that can guarantee both the partial differential equations and boundary conditions consistent in logic. In reverse, if a general mathematical model is perfect in logic, it can not only allow us to effectively use the computation methods supplied by computational mathematics but also provide more full and more exact information about electromagnetic field.

articleTitle: Modern spectral analysis of the UWB magnitometric signals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The short-time Fourier transform, the adaptive Fourier transform and the wavelet analysis for investigations of the geomagnetic field ultrawideband (UWB) signals accompanying the different high-energy processes have been applied. These methods have been shown to be useful applying simultaneously for the obtaining of the additional information about investigated UWB process in geomagnetic field.

articleTitle: Rectangular waveguide with strips for ultrawide band application
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The eigenwaves diffraction problem in a rectangular waveguide by strips is considered. The set of strips are placed in the same plane along the weveguide. Waveguide is filled by non-ideal dielectric. The operator approach in combination with the singular integral equations and spectral-domain approach is used. The system of integral equations for a single cell is reduced to the system of singular integral equations with additional conditions and is solved by the method of discrete singularities. The structurepsilas properties in the whole with finite number of discontinuities are obtained by the operator approach by use the reflection and transmission operators of single cell. Dependencies of reflection coefficient as a function of frequency and distance between strips are represented. They allow to determine passbands and stopbands. The properties of such structures allow to design frequency selection devices with high level of parameters.

articleTitle: Universal system of monitoring and control on the basis of the NGN concept
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In article results of working out of universal system of monitoring and managing are presented. The primary tasks solved by the multiservice system are listed. There are described the general principles of separate components construction intended for the decision of problems in the most important and interesting areas: medicine, objects guard, fire-control guard, agriculture, intellectual buildings. The short description of practically realized module of the video observation including the camera, the controller and the software is given.

articleTitle: Atomic functions in Choi-Williams analysis of the ultrawideband signals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Atomic functions (AF) and Kravchenko-Rvachev’s window functions based on them are proposed to be applied for the Choi-Williams analysis of the ultrawideband (UWB) signals. New class of the non-linear Choi-Williams-Rvachev transforms (ChWRT) is considered. The advantages and disadvantages of such transforms are discussed. The abilities of the ChWRT at the sample of the UWB signal model analysis are demonstrated.

articleTitle: About pulse propagation in biological tissues. modeling taking into account dispersion and decay
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In this paper the interaction of the impulse signal with biological tissues on an example of the flat-layered dielectric (consecutive layers of skin, fat, muscular tissue) is modeled. The calculation program is received in result. It accounts the space-time characteristics of the reflected and transmitted signals for layers of the flat-layered dielectric. Influence of the dielectric permeability and angle of incidence on the characteristics of past and scattered signals (amplitude, pulse duration, a slope) also is considered. In this model it is taken into account dispersion of the dielectric permeability and decay in a medium.

articleTitle: Mode-matching in Time Domain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A new method for waveguide scattering problems analysis is proposed. The method is based on field mode expansion in Time Domain and mode-matching the fields at a scatter (iris). As an example the problem of diffraction of a pulse wave on an iris in a parallel-plate waveguide is solved and compared against FDTD solution. The main idea is in solving FDTD equations for each mode independently in the regular waveguide section and using the full-wave FDTD equations only at the iris, where mode-matching is used to relate mode amplitudes with transverse spatial field distribution. Each waveguide channel is modeled by a 1D Klein-Gordon equation, which is solved by FDTD method with a very low numerical dispersion error.

articleTitle: Choi-Williams analysis of the non-linear ultrawideband signals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Choi-Williams analysis application for the non-linear ultrawideband signal describing was proposed. The advantages and the peculiarities of Choi-Wiliiams transform were discussed. The non-linear ultrawideband signal models in time domain were given. The Choi-Williams analysis for the analysis of the non-linear ultrawideband signals was performed.

articleTitle: Mechanisms of the chaos onset in electronic circuits
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A review is given on mechanisms of the chaos onset in electronic circuits. The focus is made on the class of chaotic states which can arise in weakly nonlinear systems. Different practical devices and circuits are considered to illustrate roads to chaos and properties of chaotic oscillations. The formation of chaotic states due to the interaction of high- and low frequency modes and due to the destruction of trains of pulses in digital circuits are considered in details.

articleTitle: Ultrawideband signals former with controlled time shift
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The former of ultrawideband signals with controlled time shift for the phased antenna array is developed. Formation of coherent harmonious signals with the necessary time shifts comparable to duration of a signal, is carried out by synthesizers of direct digital synthesis. Synchronization of synthesizers is carried out by signals of the common clock generator. Distribution of this signal carries out clock distributor. The former can be used in radar systems with use phased antenna array with excitation antennas elements ultrawideband signals with the set time shift.

articleTitle: Distortion of pulsed input signal in finite-difference time-domain grid
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: We consider propagation of pulsed input signals in finite-difference time-domain grid. Factors that influence upon these signals distortion have been analyzed. Relatively simple finite-difference time-domain computing algorithm is used for this purpose. The way for quantitative sizing of input signal distortion has been proposed.

articleTitle: Propagation of sharp electromagnetic pulse through conducting media
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Dissipation of electromagnetic energy in conducting media takes place not only because of its absorption due to acceleration of charged particles by the electric field and their inelastic collisions with atoms, but also due to interaction of the wavepsilas magnetic field with magnetic dipole current induced by those collisions in the atoms. The simplest way to describe this phenomenon is to use Ohmpsilas law for magnet dipole current as H. Harmuth suggested in his modified Maxwell equations.

articleTitle: The investigation of the possibility of using linear dipole antennas for dimension of dielectric permittivity of the real soil and layered soil
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The question of the profile restoration of complex dielectric permittivity of the layered soil on the dipole antenna impedance is considered for the purpose of defining moisture gradient of the studied soil.

articleTitle: Study of planar ultrawide-band antennas
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Three kinds of novel planar ultrawideband antennas are presented in this paper. The first one is the planar circular disc monopole antenna. The radiator, ground plane and the feeder equipment of the antenna are placed on the same plate. The special structure reduces the spatial volume. The second one is the composite triangle monopole antenna, which is composed of three similar triangle metal plates. The simulation results show that the antenna not only has wide impedance frequency band, but also takes up smaller space comparing with triangle monopole. The third one is the strip-loaded wide slot antenna with a circular slot. It is fed by coplanar waveguide. The antenna can realize good bandwidth performance. The novel antennas are suitable for the wireless communications, satellite communications and mobile communications systems with good prospects.

articleTitle: Analysis of temporal structure reflected from laying surface ultrawideband signals taking into account dispersion of reflection coefficient
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The temporal structure of the ultrawideband signals reflected from clay soil with vertical polarization taking into account dispersion of reflection coefficient is considered. The analysis of the soil electric is conducted in a frequency range 150 MHz-1,5 GHz occupied by the spectrum of signal. Received and analysed shape of the impulse for the different corners of sliding.

articleTitle: A method of RCS determination in time-domain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Presently, in the UWB radars operation there is no rigorous and commonly accepted pattern of describing the reflection characteristics of a target. Since the target reflection characteristics depend considerably on a radar configuration, it seems reasonable to employ some analogue to the classical RCS sigma' (t), which does not dependent on the distance to target, on the characteristics of Rx and Tx pulse antennas and the amplitude of a pulse exciting the Tx antenna, and which has the dimension of area. The procedure below is proposed in order to determine this characteristic. A simplified structure of the radar is shown in Fig. 1. The pulser 1, using a feed, excites the Tx pulse antenna. The form of the antenna excitation pulses is supposed to be known, and, as shown below, their amplitude is to be unimportant. A pulse of unknown temporal characteristics is excited at the output of the Tx pulse antenna. The directivity characteristics of the Tx pulse antenna are also unknown. Some analogue of this antenna power gain is denoted with g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">tx</sub>. The target 3 is placed at a fixed range R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> under the desirable slant in the direction of the radiation maximum. The field scattered by the target incidents on the aperture of the Rx pulse antenna 4 as some pulse of unknown characteristics; the directivity characteristics of this antenna are characterized by g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rx</sub> parameter. The Rx pulse antenna 4 converts the electromagnetic pulse into an electric one. As a result, the ultra-short power pulse P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>(t) is dissipated over the load, and the amplitude and form of this pulse are registered.

articleTitle: Band properties of the highly rarefied arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Width of the main lobe, directive gain and the antenna array pattern in the frequency range with covering 1:20 were calculated. The reasons of the distortion of the form and the spectrum of the ultrawideband impulse signal under radiating or receiving by the antenna arrays were analyzed.

Author Keywords: radiation and receiving of the electromagnetic waves
form and spectrum of the impulse signal

articleTitle: Analytical representation for 3D fields of antenna radiation in problems of georadar sounding
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: This paper describes algorithmization representations for field of radiation of the antennas applied in GPR scanning of subsurface structures, in stratiform and two-layer soils in three-dimensional approach. Results include asymptotic representations for fields on small distances from the antenna and analytical representation for a superficial wave. Asymptotic representations of field allow eliminating singularity in numerical modeling, to consider field influence on a current in the antenna during solving of three-dimensional inverse problem of GPR-location. Asymptotic representation of superficial wave field allows to reduce time of solution finding in inverse problems of GPR scanning and to clear data of the observable reflected field.

articleTitle: Radiation from the transverse slot in a coaxial line
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Radiation from the transverse slot cut in the screen of the coaxial line has been studied by the magnetomotive forces method theoretically. Internal and external conductivities of the transverse slot as well as the radiation coefficient and the reflection coefficient of the slot radiator in the broad band of wavelength at radiation into space filled by a dielectric have been investigated.

articleTitle: Contributions to the electromagnetic theory by Henning F. Harmuth and one analogy in the history of electrodynamics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Considerable nontrivial contributions that have been done by Henning F. Harmuth to electromagnetic signal theory and UWB radar and Communication systems are briefly described in the paper. An interesting historical analogy in scientific life of Henning Harmuth and Oliver Heaviside is traced.
